text:
Morgan H: Heads up — main CI is red for integration-tests. All runners failing with KMS decrypt errors since this morning's deploy.
ci-bot: CI run #43912 failed: integration-tests. Logs: https://ci.example/builds/43912
Morgan H: Paste from job logs:
```
Error: failed to decrypt secret: PermissionDenied
cloudkms: cryptoKeyVersions.access denied for projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/runner-key
at cloudkms.Service.Decrypt
...
```
Jamie L: :eyes: Can someone with KMS/IAM perms check the key bindings? Sounds like the runner SA lost cryptoKeyDecrypter.
Arjun S: Is this hitting the self-hosted runners in prod-gke? We ran a terraform apply last night that touched service accounts. Could be related.
Lina K: Quick audit: at 02:14 UTC principal `terraform-redwood@infra` removed a binding on that key (audit log entry found). Looks like accidental drift.
Jamie L: Who can re-add `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`?
Morgan H: I can, but prefer ops-oncall to do it to avoid TTL mismatches. @ops-oncall can you restore the binding and kick a rerun?
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INFRA-2026. Assigned to @alex (oncall). Link: https://issues.redwood/infrastructure/INFRA-2026
Jamie L: If ops is slow, temporary workaround idea: mount a pre-provisioned secret on the runner pod or use a fallback key in staging. Not ideal for prod.
Arjun S: I'll open a small PR to add exponential backoff + a safe fallback flag for decrypt steps so transient permission glitches don't hard-fail the whole pipeline.
Lina K: For the immediate unblock, rebind is fastest. If we can't rely on KMS quickly, we can short-circuit the decrypt step to read a workspace secret (requires a manual token).
Morgan H: Oncall (alex) pinged and says they'll restore binding in ~10-15m. Can someone queue a rerun after that? If it still fails we'll bisect.
Jamie L: Queuing rerun now. @ci-bot please rerun integration-tests for commit HEAD from build #43912.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.example/builds/43913
ops-bot: INFRA-2026 update: binding restored at 1797654680 by alex; initial rerun passed the decrypt step but test-suiteA shows a flake — opening follow-up ticket INFRA-2026-1.
Morgan H: Thanks all. If the flake persists I'll take a bisect on the test-suiteA failures.
Arjun S: Also leaving a comment on the terraform PR that touched the SA bindings — might need a revert/approval guard to avoid accidental removal.
Jamie L: :thumbsup:
